name: ente-photos-desktop
description: Ente’s desktop updater disables automatic retrieval at setup, checks once per day, filters out non-new and skipped or muted versions, and retrieves a selected update; this file does not establish Azure Trusted Signing or notarization enforcement.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot; not historical release re-verification.
External updater-library behavior and released artifact signing/notarization remain outside the cited source unless directly shown.
